cli_smoke.human_review_reason: OOD/drift detectors were not connected; fail-closed behavior is expected

scope_and_limitations: ETTh1 LSTM checkpoint remains a 24-step OT regression model, not an industrial fault classifier.
Industrial fault LSTM/TCN architecture and NPZ training path are implemented, but no real industrial labelled dataset or field-trained checkpoint was supplied.
Synthetic industrial data validates only model wiring, serialization, bridge, routing, and gates; it does not establish field accuracy.
Group/time separation is declared and documented but must be verified by the data owner from original equipment/event identifiers.
No runtime OOD/drift detector is bundled; missing scores deliberately force human review.
One CUDA cross-device test was skipped because the current environment has CPU-only PyTorch.
